content:
**Brain Bombs** are a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

Brain Bombs are a sugary food created using Brain Fungus, Sugar Bombs, and Mothman Eggs.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Brain Fungus (3) Mothman Egg (2) Purified Water (2) Sugar Bombs (3) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Brain Bombs | | Brain Bombs (1) | 

Prior to patch 1.2.1.18, Brain Bombs never spoiled.
